notes.title: Virtual Towers Online – Big Update in UE4.27! 1665
notes.notes:
🚨 Virtual Towers Online – Big Update in UE4.27! 

Hey everyone! As we continue developing Virtual Towers Online in Unreal Engine 5, we’ve rolled out a brand-new update in UE4.27 packed with exciting changes!

👻 Scare Mazes – Now Open to Everyone!
You can now experience the terrifying SMILE, HAZZARD, and THE HIVE mazes, previously exclusive to Patreon supporters!

🎟 Choose Your Maze!
At the Box Office, you can now select which maze will be loaded inside the Bunker Building for your experience.

🚪 The Hive – New Standalone Entrance!
Instead of using the bunker, The Hive has its own dedicated entrance, located just after Towers Street on the right-hand side.

🎢 Summer Spinball – A Nighttime Party Experience!
At night, the Spinball Whizzer plaza transforms into a lively party atmosphere, with dynamic lighting and effects to bring the area to life! 🌟🎶

⚙️ Optimisation & Enhancements
We’ve made performance improvements and graphical optimisations across the park for a smoother experience.

💬 Need Help? Join Our Discord!
For more help, updates, and to chat with the community, join our Discord server: 👉 discord.gg/Fq4ujdmmnj

We’re still in Unreal Engine 4 for now, but work on UE5 is underway! Stay tuned for more updates.

What will you be checking out first? Let us know below! 👇 #VirtualTowersOnline #ScareMazes #SMILE #HAZZARD #TheHive #SpinballParty #ThemeParkGaming
